description: This file defines the Validator class in the Aws\Api namespace, responsible for schema validation against input data, including various shape checks and error handling.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: A class for validating schemas against input data, supporting various shape types and constraints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Validator with optional constraints.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates input data against a schema, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches validation to specific check methods based on shape type.

methods.name: check_structure
methods.description: Validates a structure shape, including required fields and nested members.

methods.name: check_list
methods.description: Validates a list shape, including element types and count.

methods.name: check_map
methods.description: Validates a map shape, including key-value pairs.

methods.name: check_blob
methods.description: Validates a blob shape, ensuring the value is a valid resource or castable to string.

methods.name: check_numeric
methods.description: Validates numeric types and ranges.

methods.name: check_boolean
methods.description: Validates boolean values.

methods.name: check_string
methods.description: Validates string values, including pattern matching and JSON encoding.

methods.name: validateRange
methods.description: Checks if a value falls within min/max constraints.

methods.name: checkArray
methods.description: Checks if an array is indexed or associative.

methods.name: isAssociative
methods.description: Determines if an array is associative.

methods.name: isIndexed
methods.description: Determines if an array is indexed.

methods.name: checkCanString
methods.description: Checks if a value can be cast to string.

methods.name: checkAssociativeArray
methods.description: Validates if a value is an associative array.

methods.name: checkDocumentType
methods.description: Validates document-like structures.

methods.name: checkUnion
methods.description: Validates union types.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Records validation error messages.

methods.name: canJsonEncode
methods.description: Checks if data can be JSON encoded.
